Doesn't matter - there's no code inside to be executed, so it doesn't matter whether the game is reading the file or not.
@lukilemon
You might try making a new project, putting the Quest Journal plugin in. Don't change
any
of the plugin parameters (except a test quest).
Make an event to test adding a quest in the game, make sure it works.
If that works, you can reset your plugin in your project by deleting it from your plugin manager, saving your project, then installing it again - that should reset all plugin parameters. Test again.
